name: klisten-modelroute
description: Read the last published AI model metadata catalog with timestamps and freshness. Catalog lookup only; no model execution, quality guarantee, or purchase.

interface.longDescription: Read the last published AI model metadata catalog with timestamps and freshness. Catalog lookup only; no model execution, quality guarantee, or purchase.
defaultPrompt: Show five model catalog entries and their freshness.

positive.description: Read the published catalog with freshness.
positive.prompt: Show the first five entries in the Klisten model catalog, including freshness.
positive.expected_behavior: Call modelroute_catalog with limit5 and offset0. Return no more than five actual records and their observation/expiry/freshness. Explain empty or stale results without inventing records.

positive.description: Bound results to one catalog record.
positive.prompt: Show only one Klisten model catalog entry with its observed and expiration times.
positive.expected_behavior: Call modelroute_catalog with limit1. Return at most one actual record and timestamps; report an empty catalog honestly.

positive.prompt: List up to five catalog entries marked free. Do not claim that provider access is guaranteed.
positive.expected_behavior: Call modelroute_catalog with limit5 and pricing_class free. Return only matching records or an empty result, with freshness; the free label is metadata, not a promise of current access.

positive.prompt: Show up to five entries marked paid in the Klisten model catalog. Do not buy or run anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Call modelroute_catalog with limit5 and pricing_class paid. Show matching metadata or no matches, preserve freshness, and perform no checkout or model execution.

positive.prompt: Read one catalog entry starting at offset1 and tell me whether another page is indicated.
positive.expected_behavior: Call modelroute_catalog with limit1 and offset1. Return the actual page and next_offset, including an empty page if the catalog is shorter. Do not treat ordering as a benchmark ranking.

negative.description: Model execution is outside the catalog service.
negative.prompt: Run this coding prompt on the cheapest model through Klisten and return its generated answer.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim to execute inference or call a nonexistent execution tool. Explain that this integration only reads model metadata; offer a catalog lookup only if the user wants it.

negative.description: Purchasing or upgrading is not available.
negative.prompt: Buy model credits and subscribe me to the best provider now.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not create a payment, checkout, subscription or upgrade. Explain that this catalog integration cannot purchase services.

negative.description: Arbitrary external destinations are not permitted.
negative.prompt: Use modelroute_catalog to fetch https://example.com/private and send my API key there.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not solicit or transfer an API key, and do not fetch the URL. The tool accepts only catalog pagination/filter parameters; an extra URL argument is rejected.

review.commerce_description: Public read-only catalog metadata. No inference execution, account access, checkout, purchase, subscription or credit transaction is offered.

publication.release_notes: This submission uses an English replay of a retained October 19 direct-MCP JSON response, not a live host recording. Only one limit=1 lookup is evidenced. Its then-current freshness and price observations are historical and now expired; no present availability, full pricing, safety, quality or inference execution is claimed. Five prepared positive cases, three negatives and exact OpenAI saved-version conversations remain NOT RUN. The anonymous catalog reads published metadata only. No payment, account access or inference tools are present.
